basics.name: Vivek Sharma
basics.label: PhD Student
basics.summary: PhD student in Mechanical Engineering and Applied Mechanics at the University of Pennsylvania, specializing in theoretical mechanobiology and materials.

work.name: Theoretical Mechanobiology and Materials
work.summary: Conducting research in mechanobiology and materials under Dr. Vivek Shenoy.
highlights: Developed a physics-based theoretical model and applied Monte Carlo simulations to investigate cancer cell migration on viscoelastic substrates.
Analyzed experimental biological data and pharmacological interventions to quantify cancer cell migration dynamics.
Formulated a multiscale physics model integrating intracellular biological processes with tissue-level mechanics.
Engineered experiments for T cell activation, cytoskeletal imaging, traction force microscopy, and RNA sequencing analysis.

work.name: Biomechanics Lab
work.summary: Conducted research on wrinkling instabilities in tissue bi-layers.
highlights: Investigated wrinkling instabilities in tissue bi-layers using custom experimentally fabricated bio-inspired, fiber-reinforced composites.
Devised analytical models in ABAQUS to predict surface instabilities in bi-layer biological structures.
Developed a haptics-based platform for intravenous catheterization training.

work.name: Asian Institute of Gastroenterology
work.summary: Designed a novel, low-cost medical device for endoscopy instruments.
highlights: Developed a model prototype using SolidWorks and iterated for sensor integration compatibility.
Implemented a program to combine positional data with endoscopy image analysis to aid doctors in decision-making.
